data_confidence_caveat: PropertyGuru / 99.co / EdgeProp / SRX returned HTTP 403 or DNS blocks to automated access this run (as on 2026-06-06). All figures triangulated from indexed search snippets, agent/PropNex/Huttons sites, aggregator caches (PropKaki, ShiokNest, HomeJourney) and URA-caveat summaries. Many cached listing dates are Apr-Jul 2026, so a true 7-day new-listing count could NOT be verified. Asking prices run ~5-15% above transacted. Transaction-caveat-backed points are higher confidence than pure asking prices. Re-verify any shortlisted unit against URA REALIS before acting.

psf_cap_vs_market_gap.implied_psf_ceiling: At >=1000 sqft and $2.0-2.2M, the hard filter implies an effective PSF ceiling of ~$2,000-$2,200 psf.
psf_cap_vs_market_gap.D15: Q2 2026 median ~$2,323 psf -> the cap sits ~5-13% BELOW D15 median. In-band D15 hunting = below-median-PSF stock (older/boutique/ground or low floor). Structurally tight.
psf_cap_vs_market_gap.D19_kovan_freehold: Freehold ≥1000sqft 3BR mostly price JUST ABOVE $2.2M (Oasis Garden ~$1,915 psf -> $2.35M; Botanique $2,343-2,517 psf). Kovan FH median is lower (~$1,500-1,900 psf), so Fiorenza fits at $1,549 psf - the cap is right at the market here.
psf_cap_vs_market_gap.D14_paya_lebar: Paya Lebar Residences transacts ~$1,804-1,831 psf -> genuine HEADROOM under the cap; an in-band 3BR is the most achievable of the three districts.
psf_cap_vs_market_gap.summary: D15 cap is below market (tightest); D19 Kovan FH is right at the cap (Fiorenza fits, most others just over); D14 Paya Lebar has the most headroom under the cap.

filter_tradeoffs.tenure_is_binding: In D19/D14 most large & new stock is 99-yr leasehold (Kovan Regency, Kovan Residences, Midtown, Botanique, Parc Esta, Dakota, Waterbank, Park Place). Requiring freehold/999yr forces you into small boutique blocks (Fiorenza 28u, Carpmael 16u, De Centurion 42u, Kovan Jewel 34u) -> accept low-rise, limited high-floor, thin supply.
filter_tradeoffs.psf_vs_district: Flexing the ceiling to ~$2.35M (or ~$2,350 psf) unlocks Oasis Garden, Fortune Jade, Kovan Jewel upper units, and (if tenure flexed) Botanique. Flexing tenure to include 99yr LH unlocks the big projects' unit count but forfeits the freehold-scarcity thesis.
filter_tradeoffs.district_tradeoff: D14 Eunos/Paya Lebar = most PSF headroom (Paya Lebar Residences) + PLQ regeneration catalyst; D19 Kovan = freehold scarcity + CRL Hougang catalyst, priced right at the cap; D15 = liveability + TEL East Coast but forces below-median-PSF hunting.
filter_tradeoffs.new_implication: The in-band sweet spot is BOUTIQUE FREEHOLD (Fiorenza D19, Carpmael D15, De Centurion/Paya Lebar Residences), NOT the big-name mega-condos, which are either leasehold or priced out. Two clean in-band listings exist right now (Fiorenza 1,421 sqft $2.2M; Carpmael 1,076 sqft $2.2M), both AT the ceiling.
